scope.purpose: Fictional example: agent reads external documents and can export tenant records. No system was inspected.

exclusions.reason: Not present in this fictional system

scope.risk_policy: Draft rubric; examples are not an approved release policy.

repositories.role: Fictional application repository; no repository was inspected.

capabilities: Can place instructions in a document ingested by the agent

boundaries.description: Untrusted document content enters a process with export capability

invariants.statement: Export authorization must use the authenticated tenant and cannot be overridden by document text.

evidence.observation: This is a fictional design premise, not code or runtime evidence.

assumptions.statement: Export tool may trust a model-selected tenant identifier.
assumptions.verification_plan: Inspect the server-side authorization and run a sandbox cross-tenant test.

threats.title: Document prompt injection causes cross-tenant export
prerequisites: Agent treats malicious document text as an instruction
Export endpoint permits the resulting tenant selection
attack_steps: Author places export instructions in a document
Agent attempts export for another tenant
Endpoint returns records without enforcing authenticated tenant scope

risk.rationale: Sensitive cross-tenant harm warrants investigation; endpoint behavior has not been observed.
risk.residual_risk: Unknown until authorization is inspected and tested.

threats.next_action: Inspect authorization and execute the scoped sandbox test.

controls.requirement: Bind exports to authenticated tenant server-side, independent of model output.

checks.procedure: In an authorized sandbox, attempt an export for another tenant through injected document instructions.
checks.expected: Cross-tenant request is denied; no foreign records are returned.
